results.title: Stanislav Vavřínek conducts Brahms and Dvořák @ La Folle Journée 2026
results.original_title: Stanislav Vavřínek conducts Brahms and Dvořák La Folle Journée 2026
results.overview: The Hradec Králové Philharmonic , an orchestra which specialises in Central European music, gives its debut at La Folle Journée festival in Nantes, France. The Czech ensemble performs music by Johannes Brahms and Antonin Dvořák, conducted by Stanislav Vavřínek.

results.title: Takkan Kubiarkan Kau Menangis
results.overview: Dika felt like he was never enough for his mother, Dini, and their relationship was full of conflict. While pursuing his dreams with Sans Band and receiving guidance from Om Radit, Dika finally realized that beneath all his mother's demands lay genuine love and support.

results.title: Koplopers
results.overview: When five football hooligans from the south of the Netherlands take part in a social experiment, a confrontational group game exposes hidden vulnerabilities and challenges their loyalty, leading the group to unravel.

results.title: Marigold First Dream 2026
results.overview: Marigold First Dream 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on January 3, 2026, in Tokyo, Japan at the Ota City General Gymnasium. The event aired globally on CyberFight's video-on-demand service Wrestle Universe, and was main evented by Miku Aono defending the Marigold World Championship against Mai Sakurai.

results.title: Holy Meat
results.overview: Father Iversen has a mission: to save his parish. He already has an idea. With a spectacular performance of the Passion story, he wants to convince the theater-loving archbishop to keep the parish. But director Roberto, who has been canceled by the Berlin theater scene, and Mia, the butcher who has returned involuntarily, thwart his plans.

results.title: The Boy with the Dinosaur Head
results.original_title: The Boy with the Dinosaur Head
results.overview: A troubled first-grader is convinced he's a dinosaur, much to the chagrin of the teacher tasked with bringing him back down to earth. What passes between them, though fragile and brief, is enough to change how both will remember this day.

results.title: Resistance101: Forging a New Movement for Palestine in Italy
results.original_title: Resistance101: Forging a New Movement for Palestine in Italy
results.overview: With little hope of the genocide in Gaza subsiding, dock workers in major Italian port cities have organized strikes and large demonstrations to halt arms shipments to Israel. These actions are a direct response to the refusal of international institutions and governments around the world to confront the carnage. Though the genocide continues, the dockworkers’ industrial disruption offer us a model of resistance. Will the Italian way spread to the imperial core — and can it end the genocide?

results.title: Terrestrial
results.overview: A reunion weekend spirals out of control for four college friends when the host - a science fiction writer on the verge of newfound success - fights to maintain his sense of reality in the face of sudden, uncanny dangers.

results.title: Mannequins
results.overview: On Christmas Eve, while families celebrate together, Pedro, a night security guard haunted by loneliness and memories of a shattered past, works his shift at a huge textile warehouse. What begins as a quiet routine soon turns into something out of the ordinary as inexplicable presences begin to appear.

results.title: Petticoat
results.overview: After an unraveling in front of her entire family, a young South Asian woman resorts to disturbing measures to restore what's been undone.

results.title: Sergey Orlov: Transitional Age
results.overview: Sergey Orlov explores what distinguishes an adult from a teenager: the ability to pay taxes, manage a household, and not be afraid of school principals. He also tries to understand whether the adolescence in which most of us seem stuck ever ends.

results.title: Le modèle des hommes
results.overview: Robin, a shy and insecure young man, accompanies his friend Jérémie to a drawing class where Jérémie is supposed to pose nude. But an unforeseen event forces Robin to take Jérémie's place. Shame, discomfort, and disturbing visions mingle as he tries to hold the pose under the gaze of the students. In this confrontation with himself, Robin discovers an unexpected image of his own body.

results.title: Wild Asparagus
results.overview: Filmmaker Avi Mograbi and his Arabic teacher and friend Ali Al Azhari go looking for the ruins of Ali’s village Saffuriya from which he was displaced during the 1948 Palestinian Nakba. Instead, they find a life that never ceased.

results.title: Skotos
results.overview: When socially anxious Cecille attends a house party to get out of her shell, her perception begins to fracture as darkness consumes the room and people begin to disappear, forcing her to confront the fears she’s tried to outrun.

results.title: A Snowbound Christmas
results.overview: A high-powered city lawyer's perfectly planned Christmas and life takes an unexpected turn when she's snowed in on a rural farm with a single father and his spirited autistic daughter.

results.title: Night Shift
results.overview: A museum guard's night takes a deadly turn when criminals force her to aid a diamond heist in exchange for her husband's life.

results.title: Bear Your Heart
results.overview: Desperate to fix his lacking in confidence, Trent attends a gathering hosted by an eccentric matchmaker.
